examples.japanese: {温度計|おんどけい}で{熱|ねつ}を{測|はか}る。
examples.english: To take one's temperature with a thermometer.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{温度計|おんどけい}が30{度|ど}を{示|しめ}している。
{屋外|おくがい}の{温度計|おんどけい}を{見|み}たら、マイナス5{度|ど}だったので{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: When I looked at the outdoor thermometer, I was surprised to see it was minus 5 degrees.

notes:
{温度|おんど} (temperature) + {計|けい} (meter, gauge). The general word for any device that measures temperature, whether a medical thermometer, a room thermometer, or an industrial temperature gauge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温度計|おんどけい}で{測|はか}る — measure with a thermometer
- {温度計|おんどけい}の{目盛|めも}り — scale on a thermometer
- {温度計|おんどけい}が{上|あ}がる — the thermometer rises
- {温度計|おんどけい}が{下|さ}がる — the thermometer drops

RELATED TERMS:
- {体温計|たいおんけい} — clinical thermometer (specifically for body temperature)
- {寒暖計|かんだんけい} — thermometer (older term, emphasizing hot and cold)
- {湿度計|しつどけい} — hygrometer (humidity meter)
- {気圧計|きあつけい} — barometer
